plan.title: Electron Shell + Login Page + Auth Flow

task.description: Create Electron project with Forge + Vite: forge.config.ts, vite.config.ts, package.json (pnpm, React 18, TypeScript 5.x, Electron latest stable), tsconfig.json. Main process: main.ts (BrowserWindow creation, IPC setup), ipc.ts (IPC handler registration). Renderer entry: index.html, main.tsx, App.tsx (React root with router). Platform abstraction layer: platform/types.ts (PlatformAPI interface), platform/electron.ts (real IPC), platform/web.ts (browser fallbacks). CSS design tokens: styles/tokens.css with all --sc-* custom properties from UI spec Section 1 (colours, spacing, typography, shadows). Base global styles: index.css.
task.files: client/forge.config.ts, client/vite.config.ts, client/package.json, client/tsconfig.json, client/src/main/main.ts, client/src/main/ipc.ts, client/src/renderer/index.html, client/src/renderer/main.tsx, client/src/renderer/App.tsx, client/src/platform/types.ts, client/src/platform/electron.ts, client/src/platform/web.ts, client/src/renderer/styles/tokens.css, client/src/renderer/index.css
task.verification: pnpm install succeeds. pnpm start launches Electron window. React app renders. CSS tokens loaded. Platform abstraction layer compiles.
task.done-condition: Electron app launches with React renderer, CSS tokens applied, platform abstraction in place

task.description: Create API client layer and auth flow: api/client.ts (httpx-style client with base URL configuration, JWT Bearer header injection, automatic 401 → refresh retry), api/sse.ts (SSE client stub — full implementation Phase 2). Auth flow: safeStorage integration via Electron main process IPC for token persist/retrieve/clear. "Remember me" toggle: checked → persist refresh token in safeStorage, unchecked → clear on app close. Token refresh: on 401 response, call POST /api/v1/auth/refresh, retry original request. Expired refresh → redirect to login. Generate TypeScript types from OpenAPI spec (openapi-typescript): api/generated/ directory, pnpm codegen script in package.json.
task.verification: API client sends Bearer header. 401 triggers refresh. Expired refresh redirects to login. safeStorage persists tokens across app restart. openapi-typescript codegen runs.
task.done-condition: Auth tokens stored in safeStorage, automatic refresh works, API client interceptor handles 401, codegen pipeline functional

dimension.name: knowledge
dimension.rationale: Electron IPC patterns, token refresh interceptor

task.description: Create Login page: LoginView.tsx — two-column layout (dark branding left panel / white form right panel). Standard login form: username, password, "Remember me" checkbox, "Sign In" button. First-run variant: when GET /health returns setup_required=true, show "Create Admin Account" form instead (username, password, confirm password, "Create Account" button). POST /api/v1/auth/register on first run, POST /api/v1/auth/login on subsequent. PasswordChangeView.tsx — forced password change dialog shown when must_change_password=true in login response. Calls POST /api/v1/auth/change-password. Radix UI primitives for form inputs. CSS Modules with .sc- prefix. Structural fidelity to prototype (correct layout, --sc-* tokens applied, not pixel-perfect).
task.verification: Login page renders with two-column layout. First-run shows admin creation form. Login submits correctly. Password change dialog enforced when must_change_password=true. CSS tokens applied.
task.done-condition: Full login flow: first-run admin creation → login → forced password change (when flagged) → redirect to app shell
